CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acces_dignitaire_interne(p_nom text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.postes_attribues a WHERE a.titulaire = p_nom
                    AND (a.poste_id IN ('president', 'pm') OR a.poste_id LIKE 'min\_%'))
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cycles_electoraux c WHERE c.id LIKE '%\_president' AND c.data::jsonb->>'eluId' = p_nom)
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ambassades_ouvertes a WHERE a.data->>'ambassadeur' = p_nom)
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.personnages_donnees d WHERE d.name = p_nom
                    AND (d.poste_depute IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(d.poste_depute) = 'object'
                         OR d.poste->>'id' IN ('president', 'pm') OR coalesce(d.poste->>'id', '') LIKE 'min\_%'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acces_piece_reservee_interne(p_batiment text, p_piece text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT (p_batiment = 'pavillon-ambassadeurs-novomirsk'
           AND p_piece IN ('bar', 'salle_reception', 'suite_privee', 'suite_presidentielle', 'suite_parti'))
      OR (p_batiment = 'residence-imperiale-novomirsk'
           AND p_piece IN ('appartement_1', 'appartement_2', 'appartement_3', 'appartement_4', 'grand_appartement'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acteur_poste_courant()
 RETURNS TABLE(nom text, poste_id text, poste_city text, pays text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT p.name, p.poste->>'id', p.poste->>'city',
         coalesce(
           (SELECT a.country FROM public.postes_attribues a
             WHERE a.titulaire = p.name AND a.poste_id = p.poste->>'id'
               AND (p.poste->>'city' IS NULL OR a.city IS NULL OR a.city = p.poste->>'city')
             ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1),
           CASE WHEN p.poste->>'compagnieId' LIKE 'compagnie-%-%'
                THEN nullif(split_part(p.poste->>'compagnieId', '-', 2), '') END,
           p.country)
    FROM public.personnages_donnees p
   WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid()
   LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_pnj_titulaire(p_pays text, p_poste text, p_ville text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.personnages_donnees d
       WHERE d.country = p_pays AND (d.poste ->> 'id') = p_poste
         AND (d.poste ->> 'city') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_ville)
    THEN NULL
    ELSE (SELECT t.nom_pnj FROM public.titulaires_pnj t
           WHERE t.country = p_pays AND t.poste_id = p_poste
             AND t.city IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_ville LIMIT 1)
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.affaire_audience_ouverte(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(p_data ? 'audience_ouverte_le', false); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.affaire_delai_expire(p_data jsonb, p_pays text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT (p_data ->> 'delai_jugement_jour') IS NOT NULL
     AND coalesce(public.jour_de_jeu_pays(coalesce(p_pays, p_data ->> 'country')), 1)
         > (p_data ->> 'delai_jugement_jour')::integer;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_position_effective(p_agent_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pays text, ville text, building_id text, room_id text, porte boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN ag.leader_courant IS NULL THEN ag.pays        ELSE d.country          END,
    CASE WHEN ag.leader_courant IS NULL THEN ag.ville       ELSE d.current_city     END,
    CASE WHEN ag.leader_courant IS NULL THEN ag.building_id ELSE d.current_building END,
    CASE WHEN ag.leader_courant IS NULL THEN ag.room_id     ELSE d.current_room     END,
    ag.leader_courant IS NOT NULL
  FROM public.agents_renseignement ag
  LEFT JOIN public.personnages_donnees d ON d.name = ag.leader_courant
  WHERE ag.id = p_agent_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ambassade_dossier_menace(p_nom text, p_pays text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.justice_recherches(p_nom) r
                  WHERE r.country IS NULL OR r.country = p_pays)
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.plaintes_en_cours p
                  WHERE p.country = p_pays
                    AND left(btrim(coalesce(p.data, '')), 1) = '{'
                    AND (p.data::jsonb ->> 'cible') = p_nom
                    AND (p.data::jsonb ->> 'status') IN ('au_parquet','enquete','poursuites',
                                                         'saisie','abandon_demande','appel'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ambassade_identite(p_empire text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE p_empire
    WHEN 'republic' THEN jsonb_build_object('ambassadeur','Hubert de La Courtoisie', 'ambassade','Ambassade de Républia')
    WHEN 'soviet'  THEN jsonb_build_object('ambassadeur','Valery Antonov',      'ambassade','Ambassade de Sovarka')
    WHEN 'narco'   THEN jsonb_build_object('ambassadeur','Guillermo Vasquez',   'ambassade','Ambassade d''El Estado')
    WHEN 'khalija' THEN jsonb_build_object('ambassadeur','Mohamed Al-Mansoori', 'ambassade','Ambassade d''Al-Khalija')
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ambassade_refuge_de(p_nom text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT empire FROM public.ambassades_asiles
   WHERE demandeur = p_nom AND statut = 'accorde' LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ambassade_refugie_protege(p_nom text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.ambassade_refuge_de(p_nom) IS NOT NULL
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.personnages_donnees d
                  WHERE d.name = p_nom AND d.current_building = 'quartier-ambassades');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ambassades_asiles_echoir(p_demandeur text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ DECLARE r record; v_ident jsonb; v_ok boolean; v_n integer := 0; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT * FROM public.ambassades_asiles WHERE statut = 'demandee' AND decision_prevue_le <= now() AND (p_demandeur IS NULL OR demandeur = p_demandeur) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LOOP v_ok := public.ambassade_dossier_menace(r.demandeur, r.pays_hote); UPDATE public.ambassades_asiles SET statut = CASE WHEN v_ok THEN 'accorde' ELSE 'refuse' END, decide_le = now() WHERE id = r.id; v_ident := public.ambassade_identite(r.empire); IF v_ok THEN PERFORM public.mail_systeme_poser_interne( v_ident ->> 'ambassade', r.demandeur, 'Asile politique accordé', 'Après examen de votre dossier, Son Excellence ' || (v_ident ->> 'ambassadeur') || ' vous accorde l''asile politique.

' || 'Vous êtes en sécurité tant que vous restez au Quartier des Ambassades, et le bureau de l''' || (v_ident ->> 'ambassade') || ' vous est ouvert. Dès que vous en sortez, vous pouvez être arrêté(e).

' || 'Le secrétariat de l''' || (v_ident ->> 'ambassade')); ELSE PERFORM public.mail_systeme_poser_interne( v_ident ->> 'ambassade', r.demandeur, 'Demande d''asile refusée', 'Après examen de votre dossier, l''' || (v_ident ->> 'ambassade') || ' ne peut donner suite à votre demande : rien n''y établit que vous soyez menacé(e).

' || 'Le secrétariat de l''' || (v_ident ->> 'ambassade')); END IF; v_n := v_n + 1; END LOOP; RETURN v_n; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ambassades_audiences_echoir(p_demandeur text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ DECLARE r record; v_id jsonb; v_n integer := 0; BEGIN UPDATE public.ambassades_audiences SET statut = 'expiree' WHERE statut = 'accordee' AND expire_le <= now() AND (p_demandeur IS NULL OR demandeur = p_demandeur); FOR r IN SELECT * FROM public.ambassades_audiences WHERE statut = 'demandee' AND ambassadeur_pj IS NULL AND accord_prevu_le <= now() AND (p_demandeur IS NULL OR demandeur = p_demandeur) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LOOP UPDATE public.ambassades_audiences SET statut = 'accordee', accordee_le = now(), expire_le = now() + interval '48 hours' WHERE id = r.id; v_id := public.ambassade_identite(r.empire); PERFORM public.mail_systeme_poser_interne( v_id ->> 'ambassade', r.demandeur, 'Audience accordée', 'Son Excellence ' || (v_id ->> 'ambassadeur') || ' accepte de vous recevoir.

' || 'Présentez-vous à son bureau, au Quartier des Ambassades de Luthécia, dans les 48 heures. ' || 'Passé ce délai, l''audience sera caduque et il vous faudra en solliciter une nouvelle.

' || 'Le secrétariat de l''' || (v_id ->> 'ambassade')); v_n := v_n + 1; END LOOP; RETURN v_n; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.batiment_etat_lire(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN p_data IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb
              WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_data) = 'string' THEN (p_data #>> '{}')::jsonb
              ELSE p_data END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.batiment_jouissance_integrale_interne(p_acteur text, p_pays text, p_ville text, p_batiment text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH t AS (
    SELECT coalesce(nullif(te.proprietaire, ''), te.data::jsonb->>'proprietaire') AS prop, te.coproprietaire AS copro,
           coalesce(nullif(te.niveau_construction, ''), te.data::jsonb->>'niveau_construction') AS niveau, te.data::jsonb AS d
      FROM public.terrains_etat te
     WHERE te.country = p_pays AND te.building_id = p_batiment AND coalesce(te.data::jsonb->>'city', p_ville) = p_ville
     LIMIT 1),
  moi AS (
    SELECT t.*, (replace(coalesce(t.prop, ''), 'pj:', '') = p_acteur OR replace(coalesce(t.copro, ''), 'pj:', '') = p_acteur
             OR (left(coalesce(t.prop, ''), 5) = 'orga:' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organisations o
                  WHERE o.id = substr(t.prop, 6) AND (o.data::jsonb->>'chef' = p_acteur OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.data::jsonb->'membres') = 'array'
                                                       THEN o.data::jsonb->'membres' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) mb
                     WHERE mb->>'nom' = p_acteur))))) AS a_moi
      FROM t)
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT moi.a_moi AND moi.niveau IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(moi.d->'subdivisions') = 'array'
                                                          THEN moi.d->'subdivisions' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) x
                       WHERE coalesce(x->>'locataire', '') <> '' AND replace(x->>'locataire', 'pj:', '') <> p_acteur
                         AND x->>'locataire' IS DISTINCT FROM moi.prop)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.locations_actives l
                       WHERE l.id LIKE p_pays || ':' || p_batiment || ':%:' || p_ville
                         AND replace(coalesce(l.data->>'locataire', ''), 'pj:', '') NOT IN ('', p_acteur)
                         AND coalesce('orga:' || nullif(l.data->>'orgaId', ''), '') IS DISTINCT FROM moi.prop)
    FROM moi), false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blocus_actif_interne(p_pays text, p_ville text, p_batiment text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT x.b FROM (
    SELECT public.batiment_etat_lire(e.data) -> 'blocus' AS b
      FROM public.batiments_etat e
     WHERE e.id = p_pays || '_' || p_ville || '_' || p_batiment) x
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.b) = 'object'
     AND coalesce(nullif(x.b->>'dernierRenouvellementTimestamp', '')::numeric,
                  nullif(x.b->>'lanceLe', '')::numeric, 0)
         > extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000 - 25 * 3600000;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blocus_ordre_refuse_interne(p_acteur text, p_fn text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.personnages_donnees p
      JOIN public.blocus_ordres_batiments o
        ON o.pays = coalesce(p.country, 'republic') AND o.ville = p.current_city
       AND o.batiment = p.current_building AND o.fn = p_fn
     WHERE p.name = p_acteur AND p.current_building IS NOT NULL
       AND public.blocus_actif_interne(coalesce(p.country, 'republic'), p.current_city,
                                       p.current_building) IS NOT NULL);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.caserne_noeud(p_pays text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT max(r.noeud) FROM public.rue_sorties_batiments r
   WHERE r.country = p_pays AND r.city = public.caserne_ville(p_pays) AND r.building = 'caserne-militaire';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.caserne_ville(p_pays text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT n.ville FROM public.navigation_lieux_regles n
                    WHERE n.pays = p_pays AND n.batiment = 'caserne-militaire' AND n.pieces ? 'corps_garde'
                    ORDER BY (n.ville = 'caserne'), n.ville LIMIT 1), 'caserne');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conjoint_actif_interne(p_nom text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN m.conjoint1 = p_nom THEN m.conjoint2 ELSE m.conjoint1 END
    FROM public.mariages m
   WHERE m.statut = 'actif' AND p_nom IN (m.conjoint1, m.conjoint2)
   ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.contre_espionnage_niveau_connu(p_pays text, p_couverture text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(max(substring(r.categorie from 'contre_espionnage_niveau_(\d)')::integer), 0)
    FROM public.renseignements_connus r
   WHERE r.titulaire = 'etat:' || p_pays
     AND r.cible = p_couverture
     AND r.categorie LIKE 'contre_espionnage_niveau_%';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.detention_active(p_nom text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, country text, city text, jour_debut integer, jour_fin integer, qhs boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT d.id, d.country, d.city, d.jour_debut, d.jour_fin, coalesce(d.qhs, false)
    FROM public.detentions d
   WHERE d.nom = p_nom
     AND d.mode_fin IS NULL
     AND d.jour_fin_effective IS NULL
   ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
   LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.detention_cible_pnj(p_nom text, p_pays_autorite text)
 RETURNS TABLE(systeme text, pays text, ville text, building_id text, room_id text, agent_id text, statut text, niveau_connu integer, arretable boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT 'agent_renseignement'::text,
         pe.pays, pe.ville, pe.building_id, pe.room_id,
         ag.id, ag.statut,
         public.contre_espionnage_niveau_connu(p_pays_autorite, ag.nom_couverture),
         (    ag.statut = 'actif'
          AND ag.leader_courant IS NULL
          AND pe.ville IS NOT NULL
          AND pe.pays = p_pays_autorite
          AND public.contre_espionnage_niveau_connu(p_pays_autorite, ag.nom_couverture) >= 2)
    FROM public.agents_renseignement ag
    JOIN public.cellules_renseignement c ON c.id = ag.cellule_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.agent_position_effective(ag.id) pe ON true
   WHERE ag.nom_couverture = p_nom
     AND pe.pays IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_pays_autorite
     AND c.statut = 'active'
   LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.detention_qhs_poser_interne(p_nom text, p_detention_id text, p_raison text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_det record; v_peine jsonb; v_photo text;
BEGIN
  SELECT country, city, jour_debut, jour_fin INTO v_det
    FROM public.detentions WHERE id = p_detention_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
  UPDATE public.detentions SET qhs = true WHERE id = p_detention_id;
  SELECT est_emprisonne, photo_url INTO v_peine, v_photo
    FROM public.personnages_donnees WHERE name = p_nom FOR UPDATE;
  UPDATE public.personnages_donnees
     SET est_emprisonne = CASE
           WHEN v_peine IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_peine) = 'object'
           THEN v_peine || jsonb_build_object('qhs', true) ELSE v_peine END,
         -- OBJET, jamais une chaine : c'est la forme que pa_repos_nocturne sait lire.
         detention_qhs = jsonb_build_object('enQHS', true, 'paLimite1Jour', false),
         -- detention_qhs_position_serveur_v1
         country=v_det.country,current_city='qhs',current_building='qhs-prison',current_room='cellules_qhs',current_street=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE name = p_nom;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.prisonniers_qhs
                  WHERE data ->> 'nom' = p_nom AND coalesce(statut,'') <> 'transfere') THEN
    INSERT INTO public.prisonniers_qhs (id, statut, data)
    VALUES ('qhs-' || (extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)::bigint || '-'
              || substr(md5(random()::text),1,6), 'detenu',
            jsonb_build_object('pays', v_det.country, 'nom', p_nom,
                               'raison', coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_raison),''),'Sentence'),
                               'photoUrl', v_photo,
                               'jourDebut', v_det.jour_debut, 'jourFin', v_det.jour_fin));
  END IF;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.douane_passage_valide_interne(p_nom text, p_mode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.navigation_passages_douaniers a
 JOIN public.personnages_donnees d ON d.name=a.personnage
 WHERE a.personnage=p_nom AND a.mode=p_mode AND a.pays=d.country
 AND a.ville=d.current_city AND a.batiment=d.current_building);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.douane_pnj_id(p_pays text, p_ville text, p_matricule text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT 'douane-' || p_pays || '-' || p_ville || '-' || p_matricule;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.douane_recherches_interne(p_nom text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, country text, ville_condamnation text, motif text, jours integer, data jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- `motif_allegue` EST RETIRE DE CE QUI SORT (13 octobre 2026). C'est le texte libre du
  -- plaignant, recopie sur la condamnation depuis le dossier : il n'a rien a faire sur un avis de
  -- recherche, que l'autorite lit pour savoir QUI chercher, pour QUELLE qualification, OU et
  -- pour COMBIEN de jours. Le retrait est inconditionnel -- meme pour la personne recherchee
  -- elle-meme, qui lit le texte du plaignant sur SON dossier par sa propre porte, pas ici.
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT j.id, j.country, j.city, j.motif,
           coalesce((SELECT sum((m->>'jours')::int)
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(j.data->'motifs', '[]'::jsonb)) m), 0)::int,
           (j.data - 'motif_allegue')
      FROM public.jugements j
     WHERE j.accuse = p_nom AND j.executee = false
     ORDER BY j.created_at;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.est_administrateur()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.administrateurs a
                  WHERE a.user_id = auth.uid() AND a.actif);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.est_appel_serveur()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN coalesce(nullif(current_setting('role', true), 'none'), session_user)
         IN ('anon', 'authenticated')
      THEN false
    WHEN coalesce(nullif(current_setting('role', true), 'none'), session_user)
         IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role', 'supabase_auth_admin')
      THEN true
    ELSE coalesce(
           nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
           (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'),
           'anon'
         ) = 'service_role'
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.est_mon_personnage(p_nom text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.est_appel_serveur()
      OR (p_nom IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.personnages p
                      WHERE p.name = p_nom AND p.user_id = auth.uid()));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.exiger_acteur(p_nom text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.est_mon_personnage(p_nom) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'acteur_non_authentifie: % n''appartient pas au compte connecte', coalesce(p_nom, '(null)')
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fonds_transit_deposer_interne(p_acteur text, p_montant numeric, p_origine text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_acteur IS NULL OR coalesce(p_montant, 0) <= 0 THEN RETURN; END IF;
  DELETE FROM public.fonds_en_transit WHERE acteur = p_acteur AND cree_le < now() - interval '15 minutes';
  INSERT INTO public.fonds_en_transit (acteur, montant, origine) VALUES (p_acteur, p_montant, coalesce(p_origine, '?'));
END; $function$

 )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.justice_peine_calcul(p_infraction text, p_genre text, p_cible text, p_pays text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_b jsonb; v_n integer; v_jmin integer; v_jmax integer;
        v_amin integer; v_amax integer; v_impose boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF p_genre NOT IN ('prison', 'amende', 'amenagement', 'qhs', 'torture') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'raison', 'genre_inconnu', 'genre', p_genre);
  END IF;

  v_b := public.infraction_peine_bornes(p_infraction);
  IF coalesce((v_b ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RETURN v_b;   -- infraction_inconnue : le refus porte deja sa raison
  END IF;

  v_jmin := (v_b ->> 'jours_min')::integer;  v_jmax := (v_b ->> 'jours_max')::integer;
  v_amin := (v_b ->> 'amende_min')::integer; v_amax := (v_b ->> 'amende_max')::integer;

  IF p_genre = 'prison' THEN
    -- La modulation du juge porte sur les JOURS, dans la plage du catalogue. Aucune amende : le
    -- jeu n'en preleve aucune aujourd'hui (voir le genre `amende` ci-dessous).
    v_amin := 0; v_amax := 0;

  ELSIF p_genre = 'amende' THEN
    -- La modulation porte sur le MONTANT. Aucun jour de detention.
    -- DETTE NOMMEE, NON TRAITEE ICI : l'amende n'est PRELEVEE nulle part. `appliquerSentence`
    -- composait « Amende de 500 FR » -- un 500 en dur, sans rapport avec le bareme -- et
    -- n'appelait aucune porte de debit. Le montant devient au moins REEL (celui du catalogue,
    -- modulable) et verifie ; le prelevement reste a construire.
    v_jmin := 0; v_jmax := 0;

  ELSIF p_genre = 'amenagement' THEN
    -- Mention au registre, sans consequence mecanique -- c'etait deja le cas.
    v_jmin := 0; v_jmax := 0; v_amin := 0; v_amax := 0; v_impose := true;

  ELSIF p_genre = 'qhs' THEN
    -- TRENTE JOURS, RECOPIES DE LA REGLE VALIDEE, pas derives du catalogue : le QHS n'est pas une
    -- peine du code penal, c'est une mecanique a part, arbitree le 26 aout 2026 et inchangee ici.
    -- Le serveur l'IMPOSE desormais, au lieu de recevoir du navigateur une duree qu'il n'a jamais
    -- verifiee.
    v_jmin := 30; v_jmax := 30; v_amin := 0; v_amax := 0; v_impose := true;

  ELSE   -- torture
    -- TROIS JOURS PAR CONDAMNATION, CUMULES, RECOPIES DE LA REGLE VALIDEE. Le cumul se comptait
    -- cote navigateur (`sbGetActionsTracablesParAuteur`) : il se compte ici, sur la meme trace
    -- `condamnation_torture`, qui est ecrite avec une expiration a +36500 jours et ne s'eteint
    -- donc jamais. C'est la meme formule, deplacee la ou elle ne peut plus etre reecrite.
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.actions_tracables a
     WHERE a.auteur = p_cible AND a.type_action = 'condamnation_torture'
       AND a.country IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_pays;
    v_jmin := 3 * (v_n + 1); v_jmax := v_jmin; v_amin := 0; v_amax := 0; v_impose := true;
  END IF;

  RETURN v_b || jsonb_build_object(
    'genre', p_genre,
    'jours_min', v_jmin, 'jours_max', v_jmax,
    'amende_min', v_amin, 'amende_max', v_amax,
    -- `impose` dit a l'ecran qu'il n'y a RIEN a moduler : la valeur est celle-la et pas une autre.
    'impose', v_impose,
    -- La valeur par defaut proposee au juge : la reference du catalogue pour les genres
    -- modulables, la valeur imposee sinon. Toujours dans la plage, par construction.
    'jours_defaut', CASE WHEN v_impose THEN v_jmin
                         WHEN p_genre = 'prison' THEN (v_b ->> 'jours_reference')::integer
                         ELSE 0 END,
    'amende_defaut', CASE WHEN p_genre = 'amende' THEN (v_b ->> 'amende_reference')::integer
                          ELSE 0 END);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.local_jouissance_interne(p_acteur text, p_pays text, p_ville text, p_batiment text, p_piece text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations_actives l
     WHERE l.id = p_pays || ':' || p_batiment || ':' || p_piece || ':' || p_ville
       AND ( replace(coalesce(l.data->>'locataire', ''), 'pj:', '') = p_acteur
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organisations o
                      WHERE o.id = l.data->>'orgaId'
                        AND ( o.data::jsonb->>'chef' = p_acteur
                           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.data::jsonb->'membres') = 'array'
                                                                         THEN o.data::jsonb->'membres' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) mb
                                       WHERE mb->>'nom' = p_acteur)))))
    -- appartements_populaires_v1 (12/11/2026) : conjoint, colocataire, chambres premium.
    OR public.logement_jouissance_interne(p_acteur, p_pays, p_ville, p_batiment, p_piece);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.militaire_blob_projeter(p_compagnie text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_data jsonb; v_secs jsonb; v_res jsonb; v_n integer := 0;
BEGIN
  -- groupes_position_effective_v1
  SELECT data INTO v_data FROM public.compagnies_militaires WHERE id = p_compagnie FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_data IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'raison', 'compagnie_introuvable'); END IF;

  -- SECTIONS. Les soldats JOUEURS (pj) n'ont pas de ligne au socle : on ne les touche jamais.
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
           s || jsonb_build_object('soldats', (
             SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                      CASE WHEN COALESCE((sol->>'pj')::boolean,false) THEN sol
                           ELSE sol || jsonb_build_object(
                                  'leaderCourant', m.leader_pj,
                                  'ville', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.ville END, 'buildingId', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.building_id END,
                                  'roomId', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.room_id END, 'rueNoeudId', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.rue_noeud_id END, 'pa', m.pa)
                      END ORDER BY sp), '[]'::jsonb)
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(s->'soldats','[]'::jsonb))
                    WITH ORDINALITY AS ts(sol, sp)
               LEFT JOIN public.pnj_membres m
                 ON m.id = p_compagnie || '-' || (sol->>'matricule')
               LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.pnj_position_effective(m.id) pe ON true))
           ORDER BY sp2), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_secs
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(v_data->'sections','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(s, sp2);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
           r || jsonb_build_object('leaderCourant', m.leader_pj,
                  'ville', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.ville END, 'buildingId', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.building_id END,
                  'roomId', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.room_id END, 'rueNoeudId', CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NULL THEN pe.rue_noeud_id END, 'pa', m.pa)
           ORDER BY rp), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_res
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(v_data->'reserve','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(r, rp)
    LEFT JOIN public.pnj_membres m ON m.id = p_compagnie || '-' || (r->>'matricule')
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.pnj_position_effective(m.id) pe ON true;

  UPDATE public.compagnies_militaires
     SET data = v_data || jsonb_build_object('sections', v_secs, 'reserve', v_res)
   WHERE id = p_compagnie;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.pnj_membres WHERE id LIKE p_compagnie || '-%';
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'projetes', v_n);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.navigation_piece_referencee_interne(p_pays text, p_ville text, p_batiment text, p_piece text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.navigation_lieux_regles WHERE pays=p_pays AND ville=p_ville AND batiment=p_batiment AND pieces ? p_piece)
 OR (SELECT count(*)=1 FROM public.terrains_etat t
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.terrain_etat_lire(t.data) e
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e->'subdivisions')='array' THEN e->'subdivisions' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) lot
 WHERE t.country=p_pays AND t.building_id=p_batiment AND e->>'city'=p_ville
 AND nullif(btrim(lot->>'id'),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND 'lot_dyn_'||regexp_replace(btrim(lot->>'id'),'[^A-Za-z0-9_-]','_','g')=p_piece)
 -- appartements_populaires_v1 : chambres d'un appartement premium.
 OR public.logement_chambre_valide_interne(p_pays,p_ville,p_batiment,p_piece);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pnj_groupes_projeter_interne(p_ids text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record; verdict jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.pnj_membres m
  LEFT JOIN public.pnj_soldats_metier sm ON sm.pnj_id=m.id
  LEFT JOIN public.compagnies_militaires cm ON cm.id=sm.compagnie_id
  WHERE m.id=ANY(p_ids) AND m.famille='soldat' AND cm.id IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'soldat_projection_compagnie_absente'; END IF;
 FOR c IN SELECT DISTINCT sm.compagnie_id FROM public.pnj_soldats_metier sm
  JOIN public.pnj_membres m ON m.id=sm.pnj_id
  WHERE m.id=ANY(p_ids) AND m.famille='soldat' ORDER BY sm.compagnie_id LOOP
  verdict:=public.militaire_blob_projeter(c.compagnie_id);
  IF NOT coalesce((verdict->>'ok')::boolean,false) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'soldat_projection_refusee: %',verdict; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM public.pnj_groupes_projeter_institutions_interne(p_ids);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pnj_groupes_verrouiller_projections_interne(p_ids text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM t.id FROM public.batiments_etat t WHERE t.id IN (
  SELECT b.id FROM public.batiments_etat b JOIN public.pnj_membres m ON m.pays=b.country
   AND m.proprietaire_perimetre=b.city||':'||b.building_id
  WHERE m.id=ANY(p_ids) AND m.proprietaire_institution IN ('police','douane')
   AND m.famille IN ('policier','douanier')) ORDER BY t.id FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM c.id FROM public.compagnies_militaires c WHERE c.id IN (
  SELECT sm.compagnie_id FROM public.pnj_soldats_metier sm JOIN public.pnj_membres m ON m.id=sm.pnj_id
  WHERE m.id=ANY(p_ids) AND m.famille='soldat') ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pnj_position_effective(p_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pays text, ville text, building_id text, room_id text, rue_noeud_id text, porte boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NOT NULL THEN d.country
    WHEN m.leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(l.position_pays,l.pays)
    ELSE coalesce(m.position_pays,m.pays) END,
    CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NOT NULL THEN d.current_city
         WHEN m.leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.ville ELSE m.ville END,
    CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NOT NULL THEN d.current_building
         WHEN m.leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.building_id ELSE m.building_id END,
    CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NOT NULL THEN d.current_room
         WHEN m.leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.room_id ELSE m.room_id END,
    CASE WHEN m.leader_pj IS NOT NULL THEN d.current_street
         WHEN m.leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.rue_noeud_id ELSE m.rue_noeud_id END,
    (m.leader_pj IS NOT NULL OR m.leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL)
  FROM public.pnj_membres m
  LEFT JOIN public.personnages_donnees d ON d.name = m.leader_pj
  LEFT JOIN public.pnj_membres         l ON l.id   = m.leader_pnj_id
  WHERE m.id = p_id;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT s.statut = 'posee' AND (s.cible = 'armoire'
    OR (s.cible = 'vehicule' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.vehicules v WHERE v.serrure = s.id)) -- vehicules_socle_v1
    OR (s.cible = 'batiment' AND public.batiment_jouissance_integrale_interne(s.poseur, s.pays, s.ville, s.batiment))
    OR (s.cible = 'lieu' AND (EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.locations_actives l
       WHERE l.id = s.bail_ref
         AND coalesce(nullif(l.data->>'orgaId', ''), replace(coalesce(l.data->>'locataire', ''), 'pj:', '')) = s.bail_titulaire)
      -- appartements_populaires_v1
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.logements_reprises r WHERE r.bail_id = s.bail_ref AND r.statut = 'en_attente'
                    AND r.expire_le > now() AND r.colocataire = s.poseur))
      AND (public.logement_info_interne(s.pays, s.ville, s.batiment, s.piece) IS NULL
           OR public.local_jouissance_interne(s.poseur, s.pays, s.ville, s.batiment, s.piece))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.serrures_fin_bail_interne(p_pays text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ville text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_batiment text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_piece text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE s public.serrures; n integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR s IN SELECT * FROM public.serrures x
            WHERE x.statut = 'posee' AND x.cible IN ('lieu', 'batiment')
              AND (p_batiment IS NULL OR (x.pays, x.ville, x.batiment) = (p_pays, p_ville, p_batiment))
              AND (p_piece IS NULL OR x.cible = 'batiment' OR x.piece = p_piece)
            FOR UPDATE LOOP
    CONTINUE WHEN public.serrure_valide_interne(s);
    UPDATE public.serrures SET statut = 'detruite', fermee = false, detruite_le = now(),
           motif_destruction = 'fin_de_bail' WHERE id = s.id;
    PERFORM public.mail_systeme_poser_interne('Gestionnaire immobilier', s.poseur, 'Serrure détruite',
      CASE WHEN s.cible = 'batiment'
           THEN 'Vous n''avez plus l''intégralité de la jouissance du bâtiment où vous aviez posé la serrure n° '
                || public.serrure_numero_interne(s.id) || '. La serrure est détruite : plus aucune de ses clés n''ouvre quoi que ce soit.'
           ELSE 'Le bail du local où vous aviez posé la serrure n° ' || public.serrure_numero_interne(s.id) || ' (' || s.piece
                || ') a pris fin. La serrure est détruite : plus aucune de ses clés n''ouvre quoi que ce soit.' END);
    n := n + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN n;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sovarka_est_titulaire_interne(p_nom text, p_poste text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.postes_attribues a
    JOIN public.personnages_donnees d ON d.name = a.titulaire AND d.poste->>'id' = a.poste_id
   WHERE a.country = 'soviet' AND a.poste_id = p_poste AND a.titulaire = p_nom) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sovarka_jour_paris()
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ssm_rendezvous_valide_interne(p_personnage text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.ssm_rendezvous rdv
  JOIN public.personnages_donnees pj ON pj.name = rdv.personnage
  WHERE rdv.personnage = p_personnage
    AND rdv.user_id = pj.user_id
    AND rdv.rendezvous_le = (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.terrain_etat_lire(p_data text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN p_data::jsonb;
EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
END; $function$
